title: Verification Vendor Tariff: Re-verifying Employment Before a Mortgage Loan File Closes
content:
For a corrected Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File, the employment re-verification line is measured in calendar days from the most recent resolved date among the cleared verbal verification of employment conditions on the file to the scheduled closing date.

**Tariff.** A verification more than 30 days old adds 62.50 USD for each borrower on the file; one more than 10 but no more than 30 days old adds 24.00 USD for each borrower on the file; one no more than 10 days old, or a file with no cleared verbal verification of employment condition yet or no scheduled closing date, adds nothing.

| Age of the verification on the scheduled closing date | Charge per borrower on the file |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days | 62.50 USD (full re-verification) |
| more than 10, up to and including 30 days | 24.00 USD (update) |
| 10 days or fewer | none |
| no cleared verbal verification of employment condition yet | none |
| no scheduled closing date on the file | none |

"Each borrower on the file" is every borrower currently on the loan file, so the line is the per-borrower charge multiplied by the number of borrowers.

## Cases (hypothetical files)

| Verification age | Borrowers on the file | Line |
|---|---|---|
| 31 days | 2 | 62.50 times 2, which is 125.00 USD |
| 30 days | 2 | 24.00 times 2, which is 48.00 USD |
| 11 days | 1 | 24.00 USD |
| 10 days | 3 | nothing |
